svg.title: OV-COCO example with VOP judgments and AP degradation bar chart
svg.desc: Frame f01 contains panel (a): zebra image at left, three caption options with person icons, a vertical VOP module, arrows to sad/happy/sad response faces. Frame f02 contains panel (b): AP bar chart with Novel and Base groups, original-label versus synonym bars, dashed performance-degradation gaps and legend. The top and bottom panels are separated by a horizontal dashed rule.
